headerDisplay: Connect MyTESY cloud convectors using the same account details as your Home Assistant TESY integration. Devices appear as thermostats with Heat/Off and a 10–30 °C setpoint.

userId.title: MyTESY user ID
userId.description: Use the user_id from your Home Assistant TESY integration. This is the MyTESY account ID, not the device MAC or your email.

exposePresets.title: Show Comfort / Eco / Sleep switches
exposePresets.description: Selecting a preset preserves the current heater power state. Turning the selected preset off returns to manual heating mode.

offlineAfter.title: Cloud outage grace period (seconds)
offlineAfter.description: Keep the last snapshot during a short cloud outage. Report No Response after this long without a successful snapshot containing the device.

staleHeatingAfter.title: Stale active heating threshold (seconds)
staleHeatingAfter.description: Stop displaying active heating when its device timestamp is too old. Old idle/off timestamps alone do not mark a device offline.

devices.title: Optional device overrides
devices.description: Leave this empty to discover all compatible convectors. A blank override row is ignored.

mac.title: Device MAC address
mac.description: Copy the MAC from the Homebridge discovery log.

exposePresets.title: Show preset switches for this device
exposePresets.description: If omitted, use the plugin-wide setting.
